name: Castmagic
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Castmagic, turn a recording into a transcript, summary, clips, quotes, and reusable content assets. The hard boundary is large prompt library, integrations, team workflow, and hosted processing, plus audio infrastructure, distribution, and production polish.
